$comment: HZ-463: the contract for a Plan's coverage review — the `plan_review` object the `Review drafts: coverage & overlap` step replies with. Like planDraft.schema.json it is the contract for an agent's OUTPUT and pairs with no data file. domain/py/plan_review.py checks it on the farm, inside the step's retry envelope; domain/js/planReview.js checks it again on the server, which re-derives every finding from it and never trusts the farm's. `coverage` maps each Inventory gap to the draft (#n) that covers it, or to null with an `out_of_scope_reason`; the bindings assert that draft is null exactly when a reason is given, which this subset cannot express. `overlaps` claims a draft duplicates an existing item; the server keeps only claims against open items in the Plan's scope.
title: Horizon Plan draft review
